stories.headline: Anthropic Buys One-Person Biotech to Prove Claude Can Make Drugs
stories.body: Anthropic said Oct. 27 it acquired Mithril Medicine, a startup developing treatments for two rare forms of muscular dystrophy. Founder Cody Tranbarger, Mithril’s only full-time employee, used Claude to organize contracts, logistics and experiments across 11 external labs and delegated other parts of the business to the model.
